question: Provide a detailed web sales report for each region, including the number of orders, total sales amount, and the name and sales amount of all sales representatives who achieved the highest total sales amount in that region (include all representatives in case of a tie).
sql:
WITH rep_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        r.name as region,
        sr.name as sales_rep_name,
        COUNT(o.id) as order_count,
        SUM(o.total_amt_usd) as rep_sales_amount
    FROM web_orders o
    JOIN web_accounts a ON o.account_id = a.id
    JOIN web_sales_reps sr ON a.sales_rep_id = sr.id
    JOIN web_region r ON sr.region_id = r.id
    GROUP BY r.name, sr.name
),
region_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        SUM(order_count) as order_count,
        SUM(rep_sales_amount) as total_sales_amount
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
),
max_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        MAX(rep_sales_amount) as max_rep_sales
    FROM rep_sales
    GROUP BY region
)
SELECT 
    rt.region,
    CAST(rt.order_count AS INTEGER) as order_count,
    rt.total_sales_amount,
    rs.sales_rep_name,
    rs.rep_sales_amount
FROM region_totals rt
JOIN max_sales ms ON rt.region = ms.region
JOIN rep_sales rs ON rt.region = rs.region AND rs.rep_sales_amount = ms.max_rep_sales
ORDER BY rt.region, rs.rep_sales_amount DESC
